messages.18ターン以内を狙う中指編成。共鳴・広域攻撃への対処・後半の集中攻撃を整理する。: A Middle team aiming for 18 cumulative turns or less. Covers Absolute Resonance, area attacks, and focused damage in Phase 2.
messages.18ターン以内向け。獲物の守備・束縛・弾の処理を分担し、主力を後半の削りへ残す。: For 18 cumulative turns or less: divide the handling of Prey defense, Bind, and ammunition, and save your main attackers for damage in the second half.
messages.1名の固定編成で進める決闘。専用の能力補正とHP下限があるため、この戦闘のために: A duel with 1 fixed combatant, special stat bonuses, and an HP floor. There is no need to prepare a different Identity for this battle.
messages.2ターン目から毎ターン3名に付く禁止規則を守り、なめされた罪人を減らして本体の破: From Turn 2, obey the rules applied to three Sinners each turn. Eliminate Tanned Prisoners to weaken the body’s Unbreakable area attacks. Punishment is Unclashable and does not activate defense: plan targets and skill types first. Clear adds while damaging the body, and prepare for a forced turn end around half HP.
messages.2ターン目の盲目を、麻痺込みでも勝てる技で止める。その後は漂流物を先に破壊し、彷: Stop turn 2's Blind Obsession with a skill that wins under Paralyze. Destroy Flotsam to trigger self-damage through “Wayward Blind Obsession”. Break the Fluorescent Lamp to limit recurring Paralyze and Bind, then damage the boss before it regenerates.
messages.2体の敵が交代する5段階の長期戦。特定の囚人を守り、最初の両手は足並みをそろえて: A 5-phase endurance battle in which 2 enemies alternate. Protect the required Sinner, damage both hands together the first time, and handle the body's Shield on the second appearance.
messages.2体の敵が続けて現れる長期戦。序盤は燭台を先に壊し、その後は毎ターン付く停止と鼓: A long battle through successive forms. Destroy candles first, then assign major clashes using Stillness and Thumping Pulse each turn. In the final form, avoid nailed Attack Skills. Let Meursault receive Shift + Delete while keeping other allies alive.
messages.2体を均等に削らず、片方へ火力を集める。攻撃を当てるほど強化されるため、今倒さな: Focus damage on one enemy rather than lowering both evenly. Hits strengthen them, so minimize attacks on the one you are not killing yet.
messages.3つの形態と続けて戦う。1つ目は回避を破り、2つ目は印付きの囚人でマッチに勝ち、: Fight 3 forms consecutively. Break Evade in the first, win Clashes with marked Sinners in the second, and break the Shield in the third. Reduce each form's Ego and damage it during Stagger.
messages.3ターンごとの全体強化とWave移行が重ならないように進める。道中で精神力・手数: Avoid overlapping the teamwide buff every 3 turns with a Wave transition. Prepare SP, actions, and healing resources along the way, then prevent nail-induced Forced Stagger in the final Wave.
messages.3人の敵と戦う。攻撃役を早めに止め、指揮役の命令に備えよう。獲物の印を受ける役と: Fight 3 enemies. Stop the main attacker early and prepare for the commander's orders. Assign a defender to take Prey Mark and attackers to deplete the Assist Barrier.
messages.3人の敵を決まった順に集中して倒す。1人目を倒すときにはフィナーレの準備を済ませ: Focus down 3 enemies in a set order. Prepare the finale before defeating the first, and account for action-change conditions that differ from their solo battles.
messages.4人で挑む2人戦。片方の敵の呼吸と月下青刀を減らし、もう片方の大技は先に別々の攻: A 4-member battle against 2 enemies. Reduce one enemy's Poise and Moonlit Azure Blade; weaken the other's major skill by landing 3 separate attacks first. Hold back during Iron Veil turns.
messages.6段階の長期戦。序盤はホンルを守り、後半は宝玉→輿→残りの取り巻きの順で妨害源を: A 6-phase endurance fight. Protect Hong Lu early; later, remove interference in the order jewel, palanquin, then remaining adds. After gaining Joy, use Hong Lu's Clash Wins to replenish resources and sustain healing.
messages.D-02支部・1層「情報チーム連絡通路」: D-02 Branch, Floor 1: Information Team Passage
messages.D-02支部・2層「重要幻想体隔離所」: D-02 Branch, Floor 2: Critical Abnormality Containment
messages.HP0まで倒す必要はない。乖離のバリアを削り切るか、11ターン目終了まで耐えれば: You do not need to reduce HP to 0. Deplete the Disjunction Shield or survive through the end of Turn 11 to progress. Have fast Sinners beat Silent Regard and Phantom Step first to make later major attacks safer.
messages.HP1で止まるのは自家発電が残っているため。まず胴体を削り、移行後の蠢く頭・尾へ: Self-charge keeps it alive at 1 HP. Damage the Body first, then beat “Wriggling Head” and “Wriggling Tail” after the transition to exhaust its stacks. Breaking the Shield is a separate approach.
messages.HP80%・60%・40%で戦い方が変わる。速度10の破壊不能攻撃へ事前に備え、: Behavior changes at 80%, 60%, and 40% HP. Prepare for the Speed 10 Unbreakable attack, and win Clashes to limit damage and lifesteal through each phase.
messages.HPを削り切るほか、特定の大技へマッチで勝ち、助力者の記憶を5までためて終える方: Besides depleting HP, win specific major clashes to build Pwie's Memories to 5 and follow the final sequence. Check Bleed and L'Abject each turn, and preserve Sinners with Shared with Pwie for the ending.
messages.J-03支部・2層「部品組み立て室」: J-03 Branch, Floor 2: Component Assembly Room
messages.J-03支部・3層「眠りに就いた隣人たちの城」: J-03 Branch, Floor 3: Castle of Slumbering Neighbors
messages.K-02支部・2層「聖所への道」: K-02 Branch, Floor 2: Path to the Sanctuary
messages.【リンバス】ボス攻略一覧｜Limbus Assistant: Limbus Company Boss Guides | Limbus Assistant
messages.まず4本の蝋燭をHP1まで削って全て点灯させる。本体の耐性が戻ったら集中攻撃する: Reduce all 4 Candles to 1 HP to light them. Once the boss's normal resistances return, focus damage on it or break every lit Candle's Shield in the same turn to trigger self-damage and Stagger.
messages.まずは打撃で右腕を集中攻撃。長引くなら3ターン目にお札を返し、4ターン目の5枚攻: Focus Blunt attacks on the Right Arm first. If the fight lasts, return talismans on turn 3 to weaken turn 4's 5-Coin attack. Distinguish talismans on your Sinners from those returned to the enemy.
messages.まず取り巻きを減らし、落酒への勝利でひとくちを抑える。ホンルは集中攻撃されるが、: Clear the adds first and win against “Waterfall” to limit Swig. Hong Lu takes focused attacks, but his death does not immediately cause defeat here. Bring reserves to recover the fight.
messages.まず確認：戦闘に詰まったときの基本: Start here: when a battle has you stuck
messages.イベントは走る、走る、走らないの順で戦闘を回避できる。戦う場合は事前のHP減少に: Choose Run., Run., then Don't run. to avoid the event battle. If fighting, account for the initial HP loss and win easier Clashes to weaken the enemy and reveal the Head.

messages.シーシュポス百貨店A・2F ラグジュアリーフロアの揺籃: Sisyphus Department Store A, 2F: Luxury Floor Cradle
messages.シーシュポス百貨店A・3F ル・ルージュのブティーク: Sisyphus Department Store A, 3F: Le Rouge Boutique
messages.シーシュポス百貨店A・4F シューズフロア 前半戦: Sisyphus Department Store A, 4F: Shoes Floor, First Battle
messages.シーシュポス百貨店A・4F シューズフロア 後半戦: Sisyphus Department Store A, 4F: Shoes Floor, Second Battle

messages.シーシュポス百貨店C・FATE LOST: Sisyphus Department Store C: FATE LOST
messages.シーシュポス百貨店C・明るい部屋 最終戦: Sisyphus Department Store C: Bright Room, Final Battle
messages.センクが私たちのフィクサーに仕掛けてきたとてつもない決闘について: On the Tremendous Duel the Cinq Brought Upon Our Fixer
messages.ダンジョンで集める「とある印」と、危険な攻撃へのマッチが攻略の軸。前半の注視を対: The dungeon's special marks and Clashes against dangerous skills are central. Handle Gaze early, then Stagger and break the large mouth in the second half to reduce attacks.
messages.ネタバレを避けるため、一覧ではボス名を出さず、章ごとに閉じてある。: Chapters start collapsed and show stage titles rather than boss names to limit spoilers.
messages.ヒースクリフ・ロージャは暴食技と害虫を処理し、大きな火力と危険なマッチは味方NP: Heathcliff and Rodion handle Gluttony skills and pests, while the allied NPC handles dangerous clashes and supplies major damage. Using Unbreakable Coins against Gluttony skills strengthens the enemy; check the NPC's clash targets first.
messages.ホンルを最後まで生かし、敵側の特定の1体への無用な攻撃を避ける。後半はホンル本人: Keep Hong Lu alive throughout and avoid unnecessary attacks on the designated enemy. In the second half, Hong Lu must win 3 Dialogues to stop the Shield, then beat the finisher to create an opening.
messages.ボスが調理しようとしている革の財布を先に倒し、食事による回復と強化を抑える戦闘。: Defeat the Leather Wallet being prepared as food to limit healing and buffs from meals. Repeatedly preventing meals triggers another major attack through hunger. Track cooking outcomes and both Unbreakable area skills while lowering the body below 30% HP.
messages.マッチで強化を削り、両腕をそろえて破壊する。片腕だけでは再生されるため、残すHP: Win Clashes to strip buffs and break both arms together. One broken arm regenerates, so coordinate remaining HP and action order, then finish the next phase quickly.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)のボス攻略一覧。ストーリーの章別攻略と、: Limbus Company boss guides by story chapter, plus NORMAL and HARD Reflectrials. Find answers to common failures, enemy skills and passives, and teams aiming for 18 turns or fewer.
messages.ワープ特急殺人事件・従える者: Murder on the WARP Express: The One Who Commands
messages.保存とウーステッド生地を育て、毎ターンのバリアと条件付き破壊不能で戦う敵。攻撃を: These enemies build Preservation and Le Noir: Worsted for renewed Shields and conditional Unbreakable Coins. Focus one enemy to reduce actions. Distinguish Count gained when the body is hit while Shielded from the other enemy's damage reflection during defense.
messages.保存威力が上がり切る前にバリアを崩して攻める。広域乱射が出たら強い技でマッチに勝: Break the Shield before Preservation Potency builds up. Win against Unfocused Volley with a strong skill to halve damage and prevent Stagger. Another enemy follows immediately after victory.
messages.傘に気を取られて精神力を削られ続けないよう、弱い攻撃で精神力を稼ぎ、強い攻撃は本: Build SP by winning against weaker attacks, and direct strong attacks at the Fox rather than spending the whole fight chasing umbrellas. Prepare for area attacks and SP loss, break Parts, and finish the Fox.
messages.全員へ攻撃を通して強化を削る。模倣する反撃へ強い技を最初に当てないよう、行動順と: Hit every enemy to remove buffs. Check order and area coverage so a powerful skill does not hit the imitating Counter first.
messages.全攻撃にマッチするより、受ける攻撃と攻める時間を決めよう。前のウェーブで準備し、: Choose which attacks to take and when to deal damage. Prepare in earlier Waves, then concentrate strong Blunt skills during Test of the Big Brother.
messages.全部の攻撃へ無理にマッチしなくてよい。勝ちやすい溢れ出る哀しみを止めて弱体化させ: You need not Clash with every attack. Stop the easier “Overflowing Sorrow” to weaken the enemy, then break the revealed head for a major opening.
messages.出撃できる3名が決まっており、各2スロットから始まる。第1Waveで精神力と資源: The 3 deployable Sinners are fixed, each starting with 2 slots. Prepare SP and resources in Wave 1, focus Pierce damage during Stagger, and shorten the period spent taking Unclashable attacks afterward.
messages.出現した緑色の粘液を捕食される前に倒し、本体の粘液が尽きたときに弱点の部位へ集中: Defeat summoned Green Slimes before they are eaten, then focus the vulnerable Part when the boss's slime runs out. Avoid repeatedly attacking the resistant Shell, and prepare for Larva's SP loss and the area attack every 4 turns.
messages.初回クリア向け。帳簿の蓄積と守備の使い分けを覚え、24ターン以内も目指す。: For a first clear: learn Written in the Book buildup and when to defend, with 24 cumulative turns or less as a further goal.
messages.前の戦闘からの連戦。コートが100になると覚醒し、基本攻撃が全て破壊不能へ変わる: Continues directly from the previous battle. At 100 Overcoat, awakens and makes all basic attack Coins Unbreakable. Winning against major skills reduces damage by 75%, so save HP and strong skills for their clasher.
messages.前半の形態では取り巻きを処理し、後半の形態では出血と拘束を管理する長期戦。凝結し: A long fight: handle adds in the first form, then manage Bleed and restraints in the second. Have an ally defeat the crystallized dream to turn it into support and prepare for major attacks.
messages.前半は指令対象への的中を防ぎ、後半は味方NPCの援護を使って生き残る戦闘。火力だ: Prevent hits on the Prescript's Target early, then survive with allied NPC support later. Use Ryōshū's resource generation and healing rather than pursuing damage alone, and maintain the Assist Defense conditions.
messages.前哨戦の子方を半分まで削ると味方の援軍が参戦する。後半は親方の予知眼を先に減らし: Reducing the opening Apprentice to half HP brings allied reinforcements. Later, reduce the Nursefather's Eye of Precognition before killing the Apprentice. Adjust NPC targets and weaken “Disposal”, whose target cannot be changed.
messages.取り巻き→1人目→2人目の順に倒す戦闘。1人目へ攻撃を集めすぎず、2人目には通常: Defeat adds, then the first opponent, then the second. Do not overcommit to the first; against the second, use ordinary Guard and Evade to limit repeated area attacks while SP is low.
messages.取り巻きが残るほど通常反撃のコインが増える。最初に攻撃する囚人の耐性とHPを確認: More surviving adds mean more Coins on the ordinary Counter. Check the first attacker's resistances and HP, clear adds, then Stagger and finish. Prepare for the major attack after the boss is isolated.
messages.取り巻きの妨害を抑え、本体の条件付き強化を防ぐ。取り巻き撃破では本体の手数が増え: Prevent add debuffs to deny the boss's conditional bonuses. Defeating adds increases its actions but lowers its Offense Level. Handle the extra attacks while finishing it.
messages.取り巻きの撃破が本体の手数と強化につながる。取り巻きはいなし、本体の危険な大技を: Defeating adds gives the boss more actions and buffs. Contain the adds and stop the boss's dangerous skills instead. Concentrate damage during the first Stagger and limit time facing Counters after recovery.
messages.取り巻きを処理してから、腕、顔の順に本体を攻める。途中の判定に使う対象を用意し、: Clear adds, then attack the arm and face in order. Prepare an appropriate Sinner for the intermediate check and preserve HP.
messages.味方NPC2人との共闘。大技は囚人の先行攻撃で弱めてからNPCに受けてもらう。後: Fight alongside 2 allied NPCs. Weaken major skills with Sinner attacks before leaving them to NPCs. Later, incapacitate the Apprentice first to reduce the Nursefather's Protection and Assist Defense.
messages.囚人3人で子方を倒し、親方は味方NPCに任せる。終盤は火力勝負をやめ、守る対象の: Use three Sinners against the Apprentice and leave the Nursefather to allied NPCs. In the final phase, stop racing for damage and protect the designated NPC from every hit for three turns. Even with plenty of HP, a hit resets the charge.
messages.回復を減らすマッチを取り、部位破壊で攻める隙を作る。破壊した瞬間に全ての攻撃が止: Win the Clashes that reduce healing and break parts to create openings. A break does not instantly stop every attack, so maintain the rest of that turn's pairings.
messages.固定の1名で進めるイベント戦。追加ダメージを持つ攻撃にマッチを合わせ、専用の能力: An event battle with 1 fixed combatant. Clash against attacks with additional damage and use the special stat bonuses.
messages.夢へと至らんとした偉大なフィクサーについての物語・最終戦: The Tale of the Great Fixer Who Sought the Dream: Final Battle
messages.夢へと至らん・病人の運命: To Reach the Dream: A Sick Person's Fate
messages.家主審査2次戦・鴻園に最も必要なもの: Second Hierarch Trial: What Hongyuan Needs Most
messages.対象変更不可の接客技は、狙われた囚人が攻撃と守備のどちらを装着するかで対処する。: Customer-service skills cannot be redirected. The targeted Sinner must equip the correct action: defense against the refusal to allow a fitting, and an attack against the invitation to try something on. Read each instruction and switch accordingly.
messages.左腕へ火力を集中するのが基本。長引くなら、高揚を妖精酒で酔いへ変え、捕食のダメー: Focus damage on the Left Arm. If the fight lasts, use Fairy Wine to convert Morale Boost into Tipsy, nullify Predation's damage, and trigger Stagger. The opening and later versions of the same skill differ in whether they can Clash.
messages.序盤に行動スロットと精神力を整えて増援に備える。回避は守備で相殺し、弱い攻撃を何: Prepare action slots and SP for reinforcements. Offset Evade with defense rather than letting weak attacks be repeatedly dodged.
messages.序盤のマッチで精神力を整え、的中による回復と速度強化を止める。目印はマッチ勝利で: Build SP in opening Clashes and prevent hit-triggered healing and Speed buffs. The mark applies even if you win, so prepare next turn's defense too. Save damage for after the HP floor.
messages.序盤は保有する時間で攻撃・防御レベルが高い。耐性と守備でしのぎ、時間の消耗を待つ: Stored time gives high Offense and Defense Levels early. Survive with resistances and defense while it is spent. Limit who attacks during the warning turn, then manage targets next turn.
messages.序盤は取り巻きを倒して本体の保護を減らす。攻撃側へ出血を返す棘と、マッチに勝って: Clear adds early to reduce the boss's Protection. Watch thorns that return Bleed to attackers and Unbreakable Coins that remain after Clash Wins; exploit the later Stagger for concentrated damage.
messages.後半は良秀1人の一騎打ちになる。落望へ先に勝って敵の攻撃を弱め、怨望・非望へも攻: The second half becomes a solo duel with Ryōshū. Beat Dismay first to weaken enemy attacks, and also target Resentment and Futility. All enemy Coins become Unbreakable, so prepare to survive hits even after clash wins.
messages.復活する取り巻きを処理して調査の機会を作る。装置を止める選択肢を選び、停止後も一: Clear reviving adds to create a chance to investigate. Choose the option that stops the device, then finish without allowing unopposed attacks even after it stops.
messages.打撃の連続攻撃を受けながら、通常パターンと試着室を行き来する戦闘。試着室のバリア: A Blunt-heavy fight alternating between the normal pattern and Changing Room. Its 500 Shield need not be broken immediately; waiting with defense is an option. In the normal pattern, recognize the skill reduced when unopposed and prepare for Unbreakable attacks below half HP.
messages.指令対象を守って指令の達成を阻止し、カルマで敵を弱める。大技は良秀、後半の憂鬱3: Protect the Prescript's Target to deny fulfillment and build Karmic Consequence on the enemy. Assign the major skill to Ryōshū, and match physical types against the 3 Gloom skills later. Limit the Unbreakable hits that remain after Clash Wins.
messages.操作するのはファウストとイシュメール。親方は味方NPCに任せ、2人は子方へ集中す: You control Faust and Ishmael. Leave the Nursefather to the allied NPC and focus the pair on the Apprentice. The NPC's Abate the Smoke removes partywide Stagger; the animation is no reason to stop attacking.
messages.攻撃を受けて開花がたまると、味方が花に閉じ込められる。マッチで開花を抑え、花の処: Hits build Blooming and can trap allies in flowers. Limit Blooming by winning Clashes, deal with the flowers, and prepare for the second-phase duel.
messages.時間殺人時間・恐怖の時計塔: Timekilling Time: The Dread Clock Tower
messages.最初のウェーブで精神力と資源を整え、その後は各ウェーブ4ターン以内に敵を倒す。弱: Prepare SP and resources in the first Wave, then clear each later Wave within 4 turns. Exploit weaknesses to Stagger enemies first and cancel multiple actions together.
messages.最初の贖罪の月桂冠を強い囚人へ渡し、その囚人に大技のマッチと本体への攻撃を任せる: Give the first Laurel Wreath of Atonement to a strong Sinner for major clashes and attacks on the body. The others handle adds, normal skills, and SP recovery. Prevent lethal attacks triggered by Panic or Corrosion, protect the Assist Unit, and aim for a quick finish.
messages.最速の囚人が観望へ勝って敵を弱め、印の付いた本人が確定された相手を止める。ムルソ: Have the fastest Sinner beat Silent Regard to weaken the enemy, while each marked Sinner stops “Destinated Opponent”. Reduce Meursault and Outis's Bladetrail, deplete each stage's Shield, and finish by reaching half HP.
messages.木の扱いは戦闘ごとに変わる。1戦目では虚栄の木をHP1にして敵に倒させ、2戦目で: Handle trees differently in each battle. In the first, reduce Trees of Vanity to 1 HP and let the enemy defeat them. In the second, defeat Trees of Desires to reduce Protection and Seeds.
messages.枝と根の攻撃へマッチを取り、余った攻撃で果実を壊す。果実破壊による全身の脆弱を使: Clash against branch and root attacks and use spare actions on the fruit. Destroying fruit applies Fragile across the body. If the fight lasts, stop the branches to prevent the area attack. HP cannot fall below 1 during the first 2 turns.
messages.次の4-48とは別の戦闘。7人の手数でバリアを削り、棘が付いたときは古傘へ攻撃を: A different fight from the following 4-48. Use 7 members' actions to remove the Shield and redirect attacks to old umbrellas when thorns appear. Distinguish SP-based buffs and Panic from Heads/Tails odds.
messages.毎ターン、お直し対象になった囚人を守備に回し、ほかの囚人で攻撃して混乱を取る戦闘: Each turn, have the Alteration Target defend while the other Sinners attack to Stagger the boss. Attacks from the target greatly increase her Power. Stagger removes Shield, Cut Fabric, and Blossom Scissors; exploit the opening with 3 Fragile.
messages.毎ターン「舌に刺さった針」を受けた囚人に守備スキルを装着し、針釘の蓄積を防ぐ戦闘: Equip Defense Skills on Sinners with Tongue-pinning Needle each turn to prevent Naildle buildup. Defeat Needlekin quickly in the first half to limit body buffs and area attacks. After the transition at 1,087 HP, finish without relying on Stagger.
messages.洗礼[赤]を守備・E.G.Oで減らし、出血を抱えたまま基本攻撃を連打しないことが: Reduce Baptism [Crimson] with defense and E.G.O instead of repeatedly using basic attacks while Bleeding. Destroy the Lifecord during Rampage, when its Protection and Assist Defense are inactive, then attack the Body. Win low-HP-targeting Unbreakable area clashes with healthy Sinners to limit damage.
messages.減算コインの敵には、精神力を下げるほど不利になることがある。斬撃・傲慢の火力で混: Lowering a Minus Coin enemy's SP can make it more dangerous. Use Slash and Pride damage to Stagger it, and arrange attacks to break the Shield before “To Claim Their Bones”.

messages.漆黒の中へ・2層 腱の橋: Into the Darkness, Floor 2: Tendon Bridge

messages.爆砕斬を後に処理し、獲物には守備も使う。マッチ勝利後に残る破壊不能の被弾を抑え、: Resolve Blasting Shatterslash late and use defense skills on Prey holders. Limit the Unbreakable hits that remain after clash wins, and prepare healing and damage for buffs that progress with HP loss and elapsed turns.
messages.特定の囚人が倒れると敗北する戦闘。変更できる攻撃はほかの囚人で引き受け、その囚人: A required Sinner's defeat causes a loss. Have other Sinners intercept changeable attacks and save strong skills for attacks only that Sinner can handle.
messages.獲物と破壊不能コインへの基本対処。大技の前に回復し、24ターン以内も目指す。: Basic handling of Prey and Unbreakable Coins. Heal before major attacks, and aim for 24 cumulative turns or less.
messages.白い月の騎士と勇敢なドンキホーテの鮮烈な争いについて: On the Vivid Clash Between the Knight of the White Moon and the Valiant Don Quixote
messages.目印付きの囚人から強化攻撃をそらし、後半は捕縛された本人で解除用のマッチに勝つ。: Redirect enhanced attacks away from marked Sinners. Later, the captured Sinner must win the freeing Clash. Similar skill names can require different defenders.
messages.破壊不能の広域はマッチに勝ったうえで受け切る準備が必要。出血と低HPを放置せず、: Prepare to survive Unbreakable area attacks even after winning their Clashes. Maintain HP and manage Bleed to prevent the fixed-target instant-kill skill from appearing.
messages.第1段階は設計図を先に倒して捕捉を妨げ、第2段階はムルソーのスキル番号を合わせて: In Phase 1, kill blueprints before “Focusing”. In Phase 2, match Meursault’s skill numbers to advance the waltz. In Phase 3, kill blueprints to lower body HP. Protect Meursault: the previous battle’s survival effect does not carry over.
messages.絡まりを守備や洗い流すで減らし、奈落の顎門の再使用を防ぐ戦闘。部位を混乱させると: Reduce Tangling through defense and “Cleansing” to prevent “Abyssal Maw” reuse. Part Stagger ends the turn and brings Pool of Black Water next turn. Clear pools with multiple Attack Skills, then prepare for predation and attacks on the Assist Unit.
messages.美しいドゥルシネーアとドンキホーテに起こったことについて: On What Befell the Fair Dulcinea and Don Quixote
messages.肉斬骨断・5.5-23と剣鬼の心象最終戦: “Yield My Flesh” to Claim Their Bones: 5.5-23 and the Final Battle of the Sword Demon's Mind
messages.肉斬骨断・黒い雲: Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones: Black Clouds
messages.血袋と前半の敵で準備を整え、後半の敵が宿した血をマッチ勝利とHP削りで減らす。血: Prepare against bloodbags and the opening enemy, then reduce the later enemy's stored blood with Clash Wins and HP damage. Evade the Unclashable area attack at 0 blood and prevent large lifesteal healing.
messages.親方は味方NPCに任せ、囚人3人は子方へ集中する。援護防御に任せる攻撃へ守備やマ: Leave the Nursefather to the allied NPC while 3 Sinners focus on the Apprentice. Do not assign defense or Clashes to attacks intended for Assist Defense, and avoid needlessly triggering the Nursefather's Counter.

messages.負けた原因を一つずつ見て、育成か操作かを切り分ける。: Review one cause of defeat at a time to separate progression issues from tactical decisions.
messages.負けやすい場面の対処と、敵のスキル・パッシブを確認しよう。: Find answers to dangerous situations and check enemy skills and passives.
messages.道中で精神力と資源を整え、沈潜と妨害を防ぐ。最初の混乱はターン終了時に解除される: Prepare SP and resources along the way while limiting Sinking and disruption. The first Stagger ends at Turn End, so concentrate follow-up damage within that same turn.
messages.難易度別の攻略。HARDは18ターン以内を目指す編成と立ち回りを扱う。: Guides by difficulty. HARD covers teams and rotations aiming for 18 turns or fewer.
